name: @extend-ai/cli-win32-x64

hlido_opinion.headline: Functional CLI for Extend AI on Windows — reliable but lacks extensive documentation.
hlido_opinion.body: The @extend-ai/cli-win32-x64 tool provides a straightforward command-line interface for users on Windows, enabling interaction with Extend AI services. While it performs its core functions reliably, the lack of comprehensive documentation limits its usability for new users. The tool is suitable for developers familiar with command-line operations but may pose challenges for those seeking detailed guidance or support. As the ecosystem evolves, clearer documentation and examples would enhance its appeal. For now, it stands as a solid option for existing Extend AI users comfortable with CLI tools.

tier_rationale: STEADY (73) reflects the tool's reliability and functionality, but the absence of thorough documentation prevents it from achieving a higher tier. Improved support materials could elevate its standing significantly.
what_it_does_well: Provides a reliable command-line interface for Extend AI services on Windows
Enables efficient interaction for users familiar with CLI tools
Integrates well within existing development workflows
what_it_fails_at: Lacks comprehensive documentation and user guides
Limited support for troubleshooting and common issues
No clear information on authentication requirements
best_for: Developers using Extend AI who prefer command-line interfaces
Users comfortable with CLI tools and seeking basic functionality
Existing Extend AI users looking for a Windows-specific solution
not_recommended_for: New users unfamiliar with command-line operations
Those requiring extensive documentation and support
Users looking for a GUI-based alternative
red_flags: Absence of clear documentation may hinder adoption and effective use

compared_to.verdict_diff: The macOS version of the Extend AI CLI may offer similar functionality with potentially better documentation. Choose the Windows version if you specifically need Windows compatibility.
Other AI CLI tools may provide more robust documentation and support. Consider alternatives if extensive guidance is a priority.

agent_relevance.agent_integration_path: None — the CLI operates independently without a programmable interface for agents.
